data.name: Hooraan
data.gender_notes: Hooraan is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root h-r-r, meaning 'to be heavenly, celestial, or sublime'. Hooraan is a name of great beauty and spiritual significance in Islam, representing the eternal beauty and peace of paradise. The name Hooraan carries the meaning “Heavenly, celestial beauty” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Hooraan usually hope their child will grow to embody heavenly, celestial beauty and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that embodies the divine beauty and serenity of the heavens.
data.etymology: Hooraan belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Heavenly, celestial beauty.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hooraan total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
